description: The brand identity half — marks, packs and the case study that explains one of them properly.
story: The identity work sits behind the installations, which is the right way round for this studio: by the time a logo appears you already believe the hands. The RK Entertainment page does the persuading — a monogram derived on a bounding grid, with the typeface argued for in writing.
